harry: quick call: when someone saves a per-route analytics view that filters a specific model, should the saved object persist a routing snapshot (region/tier/fallback) or always resolve live on open/apply? reproducibility vs brittle hard-pinning. cc @olga @rachel

olga: prefer optional snapshot. default to live-resolve so infra changes don't surprise users. but let users capture a snapshot in the save modal if they want reproducibility.

rachel: telemetry point: regardless of default, we must emit both snapshot (if present) and the resolved routing at apply-time. otherwise we lose the signal to debug regressions caused by routing changes. add saved_view_previewed and saved_view_applied events with those fields.

harry: UX idea: preview pane shows two lines: "Saved snapshot: <if any>" and "Current resolve: <computed>" with cost/latency delta. show a small badge if they differ and a toggle: [Use snapshot] / [Use live]. default respects resolution_policy.

tony: engineering: keep saved objects small. snapshot should be a compact string like "eu-west-1|dedicated-high|hint-42|tok=1200|lat=140". resolution_policy enum = "live|snapshot|prefer_snapshot". on apply, resolver returns a stable resolved_routing_id.

olga: migration: backfill vN saved objects by calling resolver at low QPS to synthesize snapshots only for objects flagged as "capture_env". write-back in background to avoid client breakage. expose both old/new shapes in read API for 2 weeks.

rachel: telemetry schemas I'll add: saved_view_saved (snapshot_present boolean, policy), saved_view_previewed (preview_mode, snapshot_vs_live_diff), saved_view_applied (saved_view_id, resolved_routing_id, snapshot_routing, model_rev, sample_rate_float, user_id), saved_view_fallback (reason). sampling_owner route|view|global as separate field.

harry: failure modes: if snapshot points to decommissioned pool, resolver should return FALLBACK_NOT_FOUND. Apply policy: try snapshot -> route-default -> cheapest-compatible. UI must show fallback reason and offer retry or apply-live.

tony: implementation note: preview cost/latency estimate uses cached perf profiles per model to avoid extra load. gate live-resolve preview behind a feature flag and A/B at 10% initially.

ci-bot: queued: savedview-resolver-backfill job @3350011255 (job/9987).

harry: ok owners: tony -> API + resolver; rachel -> telemetry + dashboards; olga -> migration + rollout runbook; harry -> UX copy + save modal change. i'll capture decisions in INF-6207. closing thread. :white_check_mark:
